summary: DeepInfra's DeepStart program grants approximately 50 billion free inference tokens at DeepSeek V4 Flash prices, expiring one year after approval. Eligibility is narrow: the startup must have raised between $250K and $10M USD and been founded within the last 2 years. Apply with a verified work-email account; personal email accounts are blocked. A team application must be submitted by a team admin (or use an account not in a team). Only one application per company is accepted; a rejected application cannot be resubmitted.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: raised $250K-$10M USD and founded within the last 2 years.
Sign in with a verified work-email account. Personal email accounts are blocked. Apply as a team admin, or from an account not in a team; ordinary team members must ask their admin.
At https://deepinfra.com/deepstart select Apply now. The form requires company name, CEO, funding in USD and founding date; website is optional.
Submit only one application per company and await review. The page also blocks resubmitting a previously rejected application.
On approval, the grant is equivalent to approximately 50 billion tokens at DeepSeek V4 Flash prices; credits expire one year after approval.
